item.text: The config currently has a hand-written Viper overlay, but it ignores the `configure(path)` argument, has no validation, and conditionally loads related settings only when their parent toggles are explicitly set. I’m switching it to a fresh Viper instance per load so file values and `FLIPT_*` overrides merge cleanly over defaults, then wiring protocol-specific listeners.

# Checkpoint

Task: add configurable HTTP/HTTPS serving and configuration validation for Flipt.

Implemented configurable `http`/`https`, TLS file checks, HTTP/HTTPS port defaults, path-based YAML loading with `FLIPT_*` environment overrides, and one-value/list CORS origin handling. Updated startup to select the configured port and TLS listener.

Verification: `go test ./cmd/flipt` and `go test ./server ./storage/...` pass. The C SQLite dependency emits its existing compiler warning. `git diff --check` passes.

item.text:
Implemented HTTPS configuration and listener support. Config loading now uses the provided YAML path, applies `FLIPT_*` overrides, preserves defaults, and validates certificate paths when HTTPS is selected. CORS origins accept either a string or a list.

Verified with `go test ./cmd/flipt` and `go test ./server ./storage/...`; both passed. `git diff --check` passed. The SQLite dependency emitted a compiler warning.
